name: Exeger indoor lighting
scenario: Illustrative 60-second lighting sequence: 200 lux, 500 lux, then darkness; ONiO sleep only, no storage or converter. Not a store schedule or batteryless-service prediction.

area_m2.note: 5 cm² absorber area from the shelf-label design target; not an Exeger orderable cell geometry. Linear scaling of absorber area is an engineering approximation.

states_lux.indoor.note: 200 lux scenario from the application discussion. Set lighting states and timed events to match the installation.

states_lux.dark.note: Zero illumination scenario; assumes zero photovoltaic generation. Reverse leakage is not characterized.

default_state.note: Constant indoor illumination between lighting events; this is not a measured daily light profile.

curve.0.illuminance_lux.note: Exeger Powerfoyle Indoor 3.0, pp. 1–3. https://www.exeger.com/uploads/2023/12/Product-Brief-Powerfoyle-Indoor-v3.0.pdf 25 °C, YUJI D50 illumination calibrated with DIG LUX 9500. Preliminary data based on PF110; custom-area scaling is indicative. Exact tabulated illuminance; interpolation between points is a model assumption.

state_unit.note: User requested power-defined states. Values converted from µW/mW into canonical watts. Fixed-power approximation; voltage dependence and input/output conversion losses are not separately characterized.

default_state.note: Return to the user-provided RAM-retention sleep state between explicit events.

min_voltage_v.note: User-supplied ONiO characterization in the project conversation, 2026-10-05–2026-10-06; not independently verified against a revision-specific datasheet. Input operating range reported as 250–3000 mV. This engine diagnoses undervoltage at the minimum; maximum remains documented in characterization.json. Logical power input, with no verified physical pin names or package mapping.
